messages:
jordan: Heads up — running the python sampleapp combo (embeddings -> rerank helper) and hitting a strange vector length mismatch that breaks the client reshape. Repro is quick below.

leah: ugh, can you paste the exact request/response? which SDK version and model?

jordan: python-sdk v0.8.1, sampleapp from quickstart (docker image). code looks like: 
```python
# simplified
emb = client.embeddings.create(input=batch_texts, model=\"openembed-small\")
ranks = client.rerank.batch(queries, candidates, autobatch=True)
```
Response snippet from embeddings endpoint (raw):
```json
{"data": [{"embedding": [0.001, 0.23, ..., <1536 floats>]}], "model": "openembed-small"}
```
But the rerank helper returns candidates with `vector` arrays of length 1535 in some calls, which causes `ValueError: cannot reshape array of size 1535 into shape (1536,)`.

aj: hmm two quick calls: 1) are you hitting any 4xx/401s before the partial response? 2) does the raw HTTP response (no SDK parsing) also show 1535?

jordan: yes I noticed an occasional 401 logged by the container then the next call returns partial data. The SDK seemed to swallow the retry and still returned a partially concatenated batch. I don't have a full raw dump in the container logs, just the SDK-parsed object.

sdk-team: thanks — that smells like an autobatcher serialization edge-case plus a retry masking the failure. We recently pushed an optimization to the autobatcher that concatenates candidate vectors into a single buffer; if a retry happens mid-append we could end up with an off-by-one float drop.

leah: can you run with env `REDWOOD_SDK_DEBUG=1` and attach the raw request/response bodies? that will tell us whether the server returned wrong dims or the client trimmed them. Also include which model from the catalog (full id).

jordan: did that, attaching sanitized snippet (link): https://redwood-internal/snapshots/1769456789
raw body excerpts show:
```json
{"candidates": [{"id": "c1", "vector": [0.001, 0.23, ..., <1535 floats>]}, {"id": "c2", "vector": [<1536 floats>]}]}
```
so it's inconsistent across candidates in same batch.

aj: interesting — inconsistent within same response suggests client-side assembly bug. Server would be consistent.

ciara-bot: incident created: INC-2026-313 rerank-embed-dim-mismatch (priority: low)

leah: I'll reproduce locally with the sampleapp image and 0.8.1, and instrument the autobatcher concat path. If repro is quick, I'll push a patch to force safe concatenation and add a shape assertion.

sdk-team: also a follow-up: the auth retry behavior should not swallow partial responses. We should make 401/403 retriable but avoid combining partial responses from two tries. Opening a small RFC: retry should only occur before the response body is streamed/consumed.

jordan: workaround for now: call `client.rerank.batch(..., autobatch=False)` and manually batch with explicit sizes (batch_size=8). That avoids the autobatcher path. Also set `REDWOOD_RETRY_VERBOSITY=debug` to see retries.

aj: noted. For product folks: sampleapp quickstart should be updated to either pin sdk to patched version or disable autobatch by default until fixed. New users hit this during onboarding and it's very confusing.

leah: agreed, we'll update the sampleapp docker tag and add a short note in the quickstart: "If you see vector shape mismatch, set autobatch=False or upgrade SDK."

jordan: confirmed manual batching fixed the reshape error for me. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

leah: patch will land in py-sdk today, sampleapp update + release tomorrow. I'll post a follow-up here when releases are cut.

sdk-team: we'll add a small unit test around autobatcher concat and a debug log if lengths disagree before raising. Also raising the retry semantics change as a separate PR.

jordan: appreciate it. saved my onboarding demo.
